attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a mouth that matches the source expression. Preserve the real source hair, specifically the strongly receding bare upper crown with short dark brown side hair combed back, and the actual dark brow hair. Maintain the clean chin with no separate moustache and the bareheaded angled stern closed-mouth bust. Keep the original small-card facing direction and head roll. No cap, spectacles, beard, or invented accessories. The dark navy/black open-lapel suit, pale white shirt, and dark tie must be preserved with their actual OPEN-lapel suit and fastening, ensuring coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadow. The rounded chin must immediately meet the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. There must be no separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No invented insignia, text, or accessories. Fine tie texture and note strokes that are indistinct must remain understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Bareheaded angled stern CLOSED-MOUTH bust, strongly receding/bare upper crown with short DARK BROWN side hair combed back and actual dark brow HAIR, clean chin and no separate moustache. Dark navy/black OPEN-lapel suit, pale WHITE shirt and DARK TIE visible beside note. Keep original small-card facing direction and head roll. No cap, spectacles, beard or invented accessories. Fine tie texture and note strokes indistinct remain understated.
Mascot green-ringed black eyes and real source eyebrow hair retained. Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
